column1: # proofs/ledger.tsv -- claims only the real services can show (Packit, Copr,
# GitHub), each with a fingerprint of the files it rests on. Checked by
# scripts/test-proofs.py (lint.sh runs it); its header has the rules.
# Everything that can be measured offline is not here but in a test suite,
# and selftest.py sees each of those checks red on every CI run.
# To close an open entry: observe it, write proofs/<claim>.md (OBSERVED and
# VERDICT lines; RED and GREEN for proven), set state, date and evidence,
# copr-runs-check       Copr runs each spec's %check and the build passes
#                       (CI's rpmbuild-check.sh does; that it is the same on
#                       Copr is what the first watcher bump of each package shows)
# reconcile-heals-live  copr-reconcile re-pushes a lost trigger on GitHub and
#                       Copr builds it. Not provoked on purpose: losing a
#                       trigger for real would leave a release unbuilt.
